stage_definitions.parameter_fit: rows used to update the deployed model when no post-selection refit followed
stage_definitions.selection_fit: rows used to fit candidates or determine a fixed training schedule
stage_definitions.selection_score: rows whose labels selected a candidate, checkpoint, or epoch
stage_definitions.final_refit: rows used to fit the deployed model after selection was frozen
stage_definitions.coefficient_fit: rows whose component predictions and labels fixed alpha
stage_definitions.scored_prediction: rows receiving the reported deployed prediction; labels must be absent from training views

overlap_policy.default: A scored row for a deployed unit must not occur in any training or coefficient stage for that unit.
overlap_policy.r02_historical_exception: R02 global preselection used the same 17,937-row population later scored out of fold. This is disclosed as non-nested and is not represented as a zero-overlap firewall.
overlap_policy.legitimate_reuse: Rows may move from selection_score to final_refit after selection when they are not scored by that deployed unit. R05 validation rows may also serve selection and coefficient fitting.

role_resolution_inputs.R02: evaluation package plus reproducible ComPlatSplit1 grouping recipe recorded here
role_resolution_inputs.R04: evaluation package plus configs/tdc_partition_recipe.json and R03 OOF dependency
role_resolution_inputs.R05: evaluation package; coefficient role is also the branch-selection role where specified
role_resolution_inputs.R09: evaluation package plus R02 global-selection and complete-OOF dependencies

complat_global_selection_recipe.group_key: RDKit InChIKey computed from original SMILES
complat_global_selection_recipe.stratification: pandas qcut up to 20 bins with minimum group count 5

R01.selection_scope: The descriptor branch uses four-way inner cross-validation inside each outer development set. Language and geometry use that outer unit's reserved validation rows. Four-head epochs were frozen from development-only validation summaries.

R02.selection_scope: The recorded R02 component settings were selected once on a global 14,351/3,586 Train/Val split of the same 17,937-row population later used for OOF scoring. Outer-fold final fitting and fold-specific coefficient fitting excluded each held fold, but representation and descriptor selection were not nested.

R03.selection_scope: Each model uses the native train-only selection subset of its outer training partition.

R04.selection_scope: The five R03 split models are reused to predict the supplied test. The outer OOF holdout is not a selection subset.

R05.selection_scope: The same reported validation rows select descriptor, language, and geometry models and separately fit the split-specific blend coefficient. Primary four-head fitting uses Train rows only.

R09.selection_scope: Descriptor, language, and geometry settings come from the R02 global Train/Val preselection. Final component and fusion models are refit on all 17,937 released Train rows.
